title: Genomic and ecological drivers of parallel arid adaptation in tree grapes (Vitaceae)
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 08 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74005-z

Succulence is a key drought-resistance trait, yet its genomic basis is underexplored. Here, authors report that long terminal retrotransposons inserted into introns may facilitate succulence evolution and genomic adaptability in tree grapes.

title: Automated synthesis of InSb quantum dots with improved batch-to-batch reproducibility via kinetically matched co-reduction
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 08 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74136-3

InSb colloidal quantum dots are heavy metal-free infrared materials, but their synthesis is hard to control manually. Here, the authors use automated, kinetically matched co-reduction to improve batch-to-batch reproducibility and size uniformity.

title: Intermolecular interactions optimization in weakly solvating ether solvents for wide-temperature Na metal batteries
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 08 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74051-7

Expanding battery operating temperatures enables broader applications. Here, authors develop high-boiling-point, weakly solvating electrolytes, achieving Na metal batteries operable from −40 to 70 °C, highlighting the key role of intermolecular interactions in wide-temperature reversibility.

title: TMEM63B regulates nucleocytoplasmic transport and placental development
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 08 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-73992-3

Skinner et al. dissects immune responses to seasonal influenza vaccination in a high-risk comorbid population of Australian First Nations and non-Indigenous people, highlighting significant baseline inflammation and atypical memory B cells.

title: Grain boundary engineered aluminum current collector for energy-dense initially anode-free sodium metal batteries
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 06 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74177-8

The initially anode-free sodium metal offer advantages in energy density and safety. Here, authors design a grain-boundary Ga-rich polycrystalline aluminum current collector that enables controlled Al3+ dissolution to compensate Na loss, stabilizes Na plating/stripping, and delivers reversible batteries.

title: Superballistic flow of viscous electron fluid induced by edge magnetoplasmons in point contacts
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 06 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-73154-5

Superballistic transport is a known hydrodynamic effect where viscous electrons can move collectively. Here, the authors provide evidence of superballistic electron flow under microwave irradiation in point contacts induced by edge magnetoplasmons.

title: Cryo-EM structures of heteromeric Kir4.1/5.1 channel suggest mechanisms of inward rectification and channel blockage
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 06 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74087-9

Kir4.1/5.1 channels are vital for brain and kidney function. Here the authors combine structural, electrophysiological, and computational studies to reveal an inner-ring pore blockage mechanism by polyamines and inhibitors, providing the structural basis for inward rectification.

title: Towards practical aqueous zinc metal pouch cell batteries via weakly bound water-mediated shear-thickening electrolyte
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 06 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74014-y

Zinc dendrite growth and corrosion limit zinc metal electrode performance. Here, authors design a weakly bound water-mediated shear-thickening electrolyte that integrates chemical regulation with mechanical reinforcement to suppress dendrites and corrosion, enabling stable zinc metal electrodes.
